name: Lip Service ~Classmate no JK wa Pinsaro Jou~
original_name: リップサービス～クラスメイトのJKはピンサロ嬢～
source: I've been masturbating to AV a lot lately and it's not enough... Since I turned 18, I decided to go to a pink salon for the first time as a commemoration. By chance, I chose a popular one and the girl who was assigned to me was none other than my classmate Yui Narusawa, who is known for her outstanding figure and beauty. She is a girl who stands out a lot and is popular with boys in the class. Why does she work at a place like this even though she is also a model? But this might be my chance... as I might be able to receive a blowjob from her as a customer, even though I usually go unnoticed in class.
translation: 最近我經常對著成人影片自慰，卻還是不夠滿足……滿18歲後，我決定把第一次去粉紅沙龍當作紀念。偶然選了一家人氣店，負責接待我的女孩竟然是同班同學鳴澤由衣，她擁有出眾身材和美貌，在班上深受男生歡迎。她甚至還兼差當模特兒，為什麼要在這種地方工作？但這或許是我的機會……作為客人，我也許能得到她的口交服務，即使平時在班上毫不起眼。
